name: document-parser
description: Extract structural information (headings, sections, entities, tables, references) from a long document's plain text and return a strict JSON object. Does NOT summarize, interpret, or decode raw PDFs. Trigger when the user asks to parse, structure, extract headings/entities/sections from a document, paper, or report (e.g. "문서 구조 추출", "extract headings", "parse this paper").
purpose: 긴 문서(PDF / 보고서 / 논문)의 텍스트를 받아 heading / entity / 섹션 단위로 구조화한다.
failure_modes: 구조 식별 실패 시 빈 배열 반환 + reason 명시
